content.title: Admissions
content.description: Your Path to Success Starts Here

stepsContent.cardDescription: Complete our online application form with your personal and academic information.
Upload your transcripts, test scores, and letters of recommendation.
Our admissions team will review your application and schedule an interview.
Get your admission decision and enrollment information.

accordionsContent.title: What is the application deadline?
accordionsContent.description: We accept applications on a rolling basis. Apply as early as possible for better course availability.

accordionsContent.title: What are the tuition fees?
accordionsContent.description: Tuition varies by program. Please contact our admissions team for detailed pricing.

accordionsContent.title: When does the academic year start?
accordionsContent.description: The academic year typically starts in September. We also offer spring and summer intakes.

accordionsContent.title: Do you offer financial aid?
accordionsContent.description: Yes! We offer scholarships, grants, and flexible payment plans.
